Method of Attack: Backdoor trojan allowing remote control access
Takes screenshots, accesses webcam, simulates key presses, interacts with mouse cursor, hides process from macOS Dock, uploads stolen data
Persistence via launch agent for hidden file
Uses ancient system calls and libraries to avoid behavioral detection
Targets macOS primarily, with some limited Linux capability
Connected to same C&C servers as a mysterious Windows malware
Impacted Systems: Windows (related malware using same C&C servers)
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious network traffic noted by system administrator
Technical breakdown and IoCs available on Malwarebytes blog
